mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Company Registry Extract) of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or corporate registrar in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille state: notarize if required, then Apostille from the designated competent authority of that state. Non-member state: notarize, obtain foreign ministry authentication, then consular legalization at the Korean Embassy/Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or government agency of the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille state: Apostille only. Non-member state: foreign ministry authentication followed by Korean consular legalization. Do not combine both paths.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing incorporation of the Korean Yuhan Hoesa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the shareholder, certified by corporate secretary or notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille state: certified resolution apostilled. Non-member state: certified resolution legalized by Korean consulate. Parallel paths only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Articles of Association (Korean-language original with certified English translation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Korean attorney or notary public executing the incorporation document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For foreign signatories in an Apostille state, notarization in the foreign state and Apostille is sufficient; for non-member states, foreign notarization plus Korean consular legalization. Never chain Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming source of funds and banking history
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution where the shareholder maintains its settlement accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille state: bank officer may notarize the letter and the Apostille attaches; non-member state: bank officer notarization plus Korean consular legalization. Apostille cannot be added to an already consularized document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Ownership Structure Chart for all individuals holding 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each ultimate beneficial owner, witnessed by an attorney or notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille state: witness notarization plus Apostille. Non-Hague state: witness notarization, foreign ministry authentication, then Korean consular legalization. The two legalization traditions are alternatives, not cumulative steps.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed shareholders, directors, UBOs, traders, and counterparties must be screened against the KOFIU integrated AML database, UN Security Council sanctions lists, the US OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions, Korean Ministry of Strategy and Finance designations, and Interpol notices. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, family members, and close associates; senior management approval and source-of-wealth documentation are required before accepting any high-risk relationship. Screening must be refreshed at every significant change of beneficial ownership or bank account mandate.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Supreme Court of Korea Internet Registry (i-Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered company name must be in the Korean alphabet, with the mandatory statutory suffix 'Yuhan Hoesa'. A trade name plus business-objective descriptor must appear before the suffix. Foreign words are transliterated phonetically into Korean; the Roman-script original may be added in parentheses after the Korean name if the company intends to use an English trade name. Statutory four-tier composition is geographic or ideological distinguishability check, trade name, business objective, and legal form; any identical or deceptively similar existing name blocks clearance.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations under the i-Registry cannot be extended; after the 30-day window expires, the applicant may immediately re-file the same name without penalty unless a third party has claimed it. If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the applicant must obtain the written rejection reasons, then submit a formal objection within 14 days through the same registry or in writing, attaching a revised two-tier candidate name list and proof of non-confusing distinguishability. If the objection is again refused, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit before the competent district court under the Administrative Litigation Act, or simply file a new application using a materially distinct trade name with different Hangul syllables.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable as the sole registered office for a Korean Yuhan Hoesa engaged in wholesale fertilizer trading. The National Tax Service and commercial banks require a physical address where management decisions are made, books and tax invoices are stored, and enterprise value is actually generated. A virtual mailbox may be used only as an auxiliary correspondence address after a physical office is secured; otherwise the corporate income tax filing, value-added tax invoice issuance, and bank settlement/LC opening will be rejected or subjected to enhanced non-resident withholding and denial of tax invoice deductions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: registered lease agreement in the company name; floor plan and site signage; payroll and four major insurance filings; Korean resident director or employee physically on-site; tax invoice terminal in the local branch; absence of shared mailbox-only address; ship and cargo documentation arriving at the registered address. Quantified risk: 35-45% likelihood of an unannounced municipal tax or National Tax Service inspection within the first 12 months when registered capital is below KRW 100 million and staffing is only one person; risk rises to 70% or higher where the company relies solely on virtual office addresses or fails to file value-added tax for two consecutive quarters.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 1000, as amended), Chapter IV on Limited Liability Companies, Articles 287-2 through 287-44; Article 317 on establishment registration; Local Tax Act Article 28 for registration tax; Supreme Court Regulation on Registration of Commercial Entities
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Court Registration Office of the District Court having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office; for a Seoul registered office, the Seoul Central District Court Registration Office, operating through the Supreme Court of Korea i-PLUS registration portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Limited Liability Company accompanied by notarized Articles of Incorporation, subscription statement, bank capital blocking certificate, organizational meeting minutes, and director appointment consents
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital exists under the Commercial Act for a Yuhan Hoesa. The organizers may declare any capital amount sufficient for the stated fertilizer wholesale business. However, the entire declared subscription price must be fully paid into a blocked pre-incorporation bank account in the name of the proposed company before the court registration application is filed. The bank must issue a capital blocking certificate, and the funds cannot be withdrawn by the organizers until the court issues the Certificate of Incorporation Registration. No mandatory escrow amount is imposed by statute, but the fertilizer wholesale business may require a higher operational capital commitment depending on bank lending and vendor credit expectations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FORMAL PRO-FORMA RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF YUHANGHOESA (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY)

Adopted on ____________________, 2025 at Seoul, Republic of Korea, by unanimous written consent of the inaugural directors of YUHANGHOESA (the Company).

WHEREAS the Company was lawfully organized under the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea and its Articles of Incorporation; and
WHEREAS the Company's business purpose includes international wholesale trade, physical distribution, chartering, storage and trading of prilled urea, potassium chloride, compound fertilizers and related agrochemical products; and
WHEREAS the Company has opened a blocked subscription account, obtained capital deposit certificates, and fulfilled all conditions precedent to incorporation;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

1. Share Capital and Subscription. The board approves and confirms the subscription statement covering the entire issued capital of the Company, being an aggregate of KRW ____________________ divided among the members set forth in the Articles of Incorporation. The organizers are authorized to obtain the release of the blocked deposits only after presentation of the Certified Certificate of Registered Matters issued by the Court Registration Office. Any release of the subscription account before registration is void.

2. Banking Authorization. The board authorizes the opening of domestic and foreign currency bank accounts with ____________________ Bank, Seoul Main Branch, in the name of the Company. The Representative Director and one other director shall act as joint signatories for all disbursements above KRW 30,000,000. For amounts below such threshold, the Representative Director and the Chief Financial Officer may sign jointly. The board specifically authorizes the execution of SWIFT direct wire transfers, letters of credit, and telegraphic transfers for the purchase and charter of fertilizer cargoes, subject to the foreign exchange reporting obligations of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act.

3. Registered Office. The registered office of the Company shall be located at __________________________________________, Republic of Korea. The Director of Administration is authorized to execute the office lease, file the registered office notice with the Court Registration Office if required, install the statutory company name plate, and register the business place with the National Tax Service.

4. Statutory Officer Appointments. The board appoints ____________________ as Representative Director and Chief Executive Officer, ____________________ as Managing Director, ____________________ as Director of Legal Affairs and Compliance, and ____________________ as Auditor under the Commercial Act. Each statutory officer confirms acceptance of office and agrees to act within the authority granted by the Articles of Incorporation and this Resolution.

5. Licensing and Regulatory Mandate. The officers are directed to apply promptly for the Business Registration Certificate with the National Tax Service, the Fertilizer Business Registration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs through the competent local authority, and any environmental, civil defense, fire safety, and occupational safety approvals required for the physical storage and wholesale distribution of prilled urea and potassium chloride.

6. General Ratification. All lawful actions taken by the organizers before the adoption of this Resolution to open bank accounts, execute preliminary contracts, and prepare corporate records are hereby ratified and approved.

This Resolution is effective immediately and remains in full force until amended or revoked by the members or a subsequent board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Search, Blocked Capital Deposit and Preparation of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: i-PLUS Korean Court Registration Portal of the Supreme Court of Korea and a designated commercial bank in Korea
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an online name availability search through the i-PLUS Korean Court Registration portal using the English proposed name YUHANGHOESA and the corresponding Korean registered name. If the identical name is registered by an existing corporation, select a permitted distinguishable name. Open a blocked pre-incorporation subscription account at a Korean commercial bank in the proposed company name. Each member must transfer their full promised contribution from a financial account beneficially owned by that member; third-party remittances are prohibited. The bank will issue a capital deposit certificate reflecting the aggregate paid amount. Prepare the Korean-language Articles of Incorporation containing the corporate purpose, registered address, amount of capital, number and par value of membership units, full names and resident registration details of members, method of convening meetings, term of directors, and distribution method upon dissolution. A certified English translation should be retained for foreign bank and customer due diligence files.
required_dossiers: Proposed Articles of Incorporation in Korean with certified English translation
Name search and availability report from i-PLUS
Capital deposit certificate from the blocked bank account
Passport or Korean Alien Registration Card of each individual member
Certificate of incorporation and incumbency of any corporate member
Power of attorney appointing the local incorporation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected due to similarity with an existing company name, submit a written consent letter from the previously registered company or amend the proposed name to a clearly distinguishable alternative and re-file through i-PLUS within one business day. If the bank queries the identity of remitters, provide certified ownership evidence and split deposits so each payment is traceable to the corresponding member.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Execution of Organizational Consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public licensed in Seoul, Republic of Korea, under the Korean Notary Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the final Korean-language Articles of Incorporation to a notary public in the district of the proposed registered office. Each incorporator or their duly authorized attorney must appear before the notary, verify their identity, and acknowledge the contents of the Articles. The notary will confirm that the subscription amounts set out in the Articles match the capital deposit certificate issued by the bank. After verification, the notary will notarize the Articles and certify the minutes of the organizational meeting of members, the resolution approving the appointment of directors and auditor, and the written acceptance of each statutory officer. If any member is a legal entity, submit apostilled or consular legalized certificates of incorporation and incumbency. Payment of the notary fee must be evidenced by an official receipt. The notarial deed is an indispensable attachment to the subsequent court registration application.
required_dossiers: Original capital deposit certificate from the bank
Final executed Articles of Incorporation
Notarized organizational meeting minutes
Written acceptance of directorship for each appointed director
Written acceptance of statutory auditor
Power of attorney and identity documents of each incorporator
Receipt for notary fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a discrepancy between the subscription statement and the capital deposit certificate, the affected member must deposit the shortfall into the blocked account and obtain a revised bank certificate before the notary will affix the notarial seal. If a director refuses to accept appointment, replace the officer through an amended organizational consent and re-notarize the acceptance before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Court Registration of Incorporation and Issuance of Corporate Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Seoul Central District Court Registration Office, Seoul, Republic of Korea
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within two weeks after notarization, file the registration of establishment of the Yuhan Hoesa with the competent court registration office. Use the court-prescribed application form and append the notarized Articles of Incorporation, capital deposit certificate, subscription report, member register, directors and auditor consent documents, lease evidence for the registered office, and proof of payment of registration tax and local education tax. The registration officer examines the application against the mandatory provisions of the Commercial Act and the Regulation on Registration of Commercial Entities. Once approved, the court enters the company into the commercial registry and issues a certified Certificate of Registered Matters and a corporate seal certificate. Upon registration, the Company acquires separate legal personality. The blocked subscription funds may be released and moved to the Company's ordinary operating account only after the certified registration extract is presented to the bank.
required_dossiers: Application for registration of establishment of a limited liability company
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Bank capital blocking certificate
Subscription statement and member register
Minutes of organizational meeting and appointments
Written consents of directors and auditor
Lease agreement for the registered office
Registration tax and local education tax payment vouchers
Power of attorney for the filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a provisional rejection, cure the stated defect, such as an incorrect address, missing director consent, or unpaid tax, and re-file the supplemental response within three business days. If a final rejection is issued, an application for correction may be filed within seven days under the Non-Contentious Civil Litigation Act, and further appeal to the relevant appellate court is available within two weeks.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax Registration, Fertilizer Wholesale Licensing and Physical Site Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Tax Service District Tax Office; Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs through the competent Si-Gun-Gu local authority; local fire station; Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the Certificate of Registered Matters, apply to the competent District Tax Office of the National Tax Service for the Business Registration Certificate. Complete the corporate income tax, value-added tax, electronic tax invoice, and payroll tax registration, and enroll employees in the national pension, national health insurance, employment insurance, and industrial accident compensation insurance programs. If any foreign member holds 10% or more of the membership units, file the relevant foreign investment report under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act through the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency one-stop service if mandated. Next, register as a fertilizer wholesaler under the Fertilizer Control Act with the competent Si-Gun-Gu administrative office; the registration must expressly include the wholesale physical distribution of prilled urea and potassium chloride. If the Company leases or operates a warehouse for physical fertilizer storage, obtain the fire-fighting system completion inspection certificate, civil defense fire safety approval, structural load inspection for racked pallets, and the occupational safety and health registration for the facility before stocking inventory.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registered Matters and corporate seal certificate
Application form for Business Registration Certificate
Application for Fertilizer Business Registration under the Fertilizer Control Act
Articles of Incorporation with fertilizer wholesale business purpose
Warehouse lease agreement or title deed
Fire-fighting system completion inspection certificate
Civil defense fire safety permit application
Structural load inspection report for storage racks
Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency workplace registration data
Employment and social insurance registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office imposes a late-filing penalty, submit the Certificate of Registered Matters with an explanatory cover letter and request a penalty waiver under the Framework Act on National Taxes, which is customarily granted for first-time administrative oversights. If the fertilizer business registration is rejected, supplement the missing documentary evidence within ten business days and appeal to the MAFRA administrative appeals committee within thirty days of the rejection notice. If the fire authority refuses approval, install the additional fire suppression or egress equipment requested and demand re-inspection within five business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs of the Republic of Korea, through the competent Si-Gun-Gu local administrative window; National Fire Agency through the local fire station; Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Fertilizer Business Registration for Wholesale Distribution under the Fertilizer Control Act, together with the Business Registration Certificate under the Value-Added Tax Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea, Environmental Impact Assessment Support Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not requiring a Full Environmental Impact Assessment for pure wholesale and physical charter of prilled urea and potassium chloride. An Environmental Registration under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act becomes mandatory only if the Company constructs or leases and operates a warehouse or storage facility with floor area equal to or above 5,000 square meters, or storage capacity equal to or above 1,000 metric tons. If no storage or warehousing activity is performed, this item is Not Applicable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or stack combustion emissions are generated by pure wholesale and distribution activities. Stormwater runoff from any fertilizer storage or handling area must meet the Korean effluent quality standards for COD not exceeding 40 mg/L, BOD not exceeding 40 mg/L, total suspended solids not exceeding 20 mg/L, and pH within 5.8 to 8.6. Ammonia concentration at the property boundary must be maintained below 1 ppm. Dust generated during the transfer of prilled urea must be suppressed so that particulate concentration at the fence line does not exceed 0.5 mg/m3. Empty fertilizer bags, contaminated pallets, and chemical residue materials must be disposed of as industrial waste through a licensed waste carrier under the Waste Control Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Civil Defense approval is required before stocking fertilizer inventory: the Company must obtain the Fire-Fighting System Completion Inspection Certificate from the local fire station under the Firefighting Facilities Installation, Maintenance, and Safety Control Act, and a civil defense fire safety certificate for the storage building. Structural load inspection is required for palletized urea and potash storage, with a minimum documented design floor load of 2.5 metric tons per square meter. The warehouse operation must be registered with the Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency, and workers must complete new-hire safety training and chemical handling orientation for fertilizer dust and ammonia release.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea; online filing and registration through the HomeTax electronic tax portal at hometax.go.kr. Export clearance and customs verification are administered jointly by Korea Customs Service through the UNI-PASS electronic clearance system at unipass.customs.go.kr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign non-resident entity establishing a Korean Yuhan Hoesa, the statutory identifier is the 10-digit Business Registration Number issued under the VAT Act, which also functions as the corporate TIN. Procedure: complete Korean incorporation under the Commercial Act; obtain the court registry certificate of incorporation; file a Business Registration Application with the competent district tax office via HomeTax or in person; attach the certificate of incorporation, articles of incorporation, evidence of a domestic place of business, and identification of the representative director. If the foreign investor has no domestic residence or office representation, the Korean entity must appoint a domestic tax representative by notarized power of attorney to receive NTS notices, file VAT returns, and maintain statutory records. For a foreign non-resident entity that does not incorporate in Korea but still makes VAT-taxable supplies in Korea, the same Business Registration Number regime is applied through a domestic tax representative, who files the simplified foreign business operator registration with HomeTax. The NTS issues the Business Registration Number after verification, typically within several days, and this number is used for corporate income tax, VAT, and electronic tax invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. South Korea does not offer a check-the-box entity classification election; a Yuhan Hoesa is statutorily classified as a domestic corporation under the Corporate Tax Act and is taxed at entity level on worldwide income. A wholly owned Korean subsidiary group may elect consolidated corporate tax return treatment under the Corporate Tax Act, but that election does not alter the entity-level classification and does not create pass-through taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold for an incorporated Yuhan Hoesa; VAT registration is mandatory within 20 days of business commencement. For individual small business operators, annual taxable turnover of KRW 80,000,000 marks the simplified taxable person classification boundary. For foreign non-resident suppliers of electronic services to Korean consumers, registration is mandatory from the first taxable supply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic tax invoice issuance through HomeTax for all VAT-registered businesses. The e-tax invoice must be transmitted to the National Tax Service no later than the day after issuance, and HomeTax returns a unique electronic tax invoice issuance number used for validation. There is no pre-issuance fiscal clearing block and no QR anti-fraud digital stamp requirement; however, the NTS performs real-time validation of registration numbers, cross-matches purchase and sales e-tax invoices, and reconciles them against Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS export declarations. HomeTax provides EDI/API channels for ERP integration so that invoice data can be filed programmatically.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Korean VAT Act and Enforcement Decree, a supply of goods is zero-rated when title to the goods passes to a foreign buyer and the goods are actually exported from Korea under an export declaration accepted by Korea Customs Service. For qualifying services supplied to non-residents and paid for in foreign currency, zero-rating may also apply if the foreign-exchange earning requirements are met; for this fertilizer wholesale scope, zero-rating is based on physical export of prilled urea and potassium chloride. The exporter must report the zero-rated export in the VAT return and retain complete proof that the goods departed Korea and that the export proceeds were remitted to and collected in Korea.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS Export Declaration (Export Declaration Confirmation) showing the physical export of the goods
Negotiable Bill of Lading or equivalent ocean transport document evidencing loading at a Korean port and discharge at the foreign destination
Commercial Invoice and Packing List describing the prilled urea and potassium chloride shipment
Export Sales Contract or Letter of Credit (Swift MT700) establishing the commercial terms of the offshore sale
Foreign Exchange Settlement Confirmation or Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Korean Foreign Exchange Bank evidencing receipt of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The NTS denies the zero-rating and assesses 10% output VAT if the export declaration, B/L, and foreign exchange receipt evidence are incomplete, inconsistent, or fraudulent. The assessment is accompanied by penalty taxes under the Framework Act on National Taxes and the VAT Act: up to 40% additional tax for intentional or fraudulent underreporting, 10% for negligent understatement, a separate false e-tax invoice penalty where applicable, and statutory delinquency surcharges on late or reversed payments. Refund amounts previously paid are retrospectively clawed back with interest from the date of refund, and the statute of limitations is extended to ten years in cases involving fraud or false documents. Serious cases are referred for criminal tax evasion prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (BOK) and the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF) through the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act; the Korea Federation of Banks operates the Foreign Exchange Information System for transaction reporting and monitoring.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The South Korean won is fully convertible for current account transactions under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. Divident, interest, trade settlement, and service payments are freely remittable through designated foreign exchange banks, subject to documentary verification and reporting thresholds. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment, equity contributions, and inbound loans, are generally liberalized under the negative list system but require filing with the designated bank using prescribed purpose codes. There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds into KRW; exporters may retain foreign currency in domiciled foreign currency accounts, provided the collection is reported through the Foreign Exchange Information System and the Customs export declaration is closed out within the statutory period. Profit remittance for a foreign-owned Yuhan Hoesa requires audited financial statements, board resolution declaring dividends, and evidence of tax withholding and tax clearance; remittance is typically executed within 3-5 business days through the reporting bank. For an agrochemical commodity wholesaler, the bank will require underlying trade documentation for each cross-border payment to prevent trade-based money laundering and to verify the economic substance of the transaction. The government imposes strict anti-abuse measures on trade mis-invoicing and misclassification of chemicals; all transactions must reflect customs declarations and arm's-length pricing. There are no prohibitive conversion queues or surrender requirements, but the Financial Action Task Force-aligned AML framework requires banks to aggregate all cross-border transactions for reporting and to block any payment that lacks a valid foreign exchange transaction reason code. The practical barrier is documentary compliance rather than quantative control; a well-kept KYC file and trade evidence package will allow seamless KRW/USD conversion and international settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Article 16 of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and the Operational Regulations on Foreign Exchange Transactions, export proceeds must be collected within 15 months from the date of export declaration unless an extension is approved by the designated foreign exchange bank. There is no mandatory conversion ratio of export receipts into KRW, but all collected foreign currency must be reported to the Korea Customs Service and the Foreign Exchange Information System through the designated bank. Uncollected export proceeds beyond the deadline may trigger penalty assessments and require a non-collection notification to the tax and customs authorities. The exporter may keep the proceeds in a foreign currency account, sell them to the bank for KRW, or use them directly for approved trade-related payments.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-negligible for a fertilizer wholesale entity physically operating in Korea. The Electronic Financial Transactions Act requires any institution receiving or transmitting cross-border funds for Korean residents to be licensed as a financial company or a registered foreign exchange business. Offshore digital EMI platforms without a Korean banking license cannot maintain a won-denominated account, cannot issue a domestic IBAN, cannot clear KRW through the Korea Financial Telecommunications and Clearings Institute (KFTC), and cannot legally act as the primary settlement partner for trade-related payments. Some global non-bank payment providers may support cross-border collection, but the final onshore settlement leg must pass through a designated Tier-1 Korean bank for the Foreign Exchange Information System and tax reporting. Prudent treasury practice for ISIC 4669 commodity flows is to use only domestic regulated banks, reserving an EMI only if the bank itself offers an integrated digital payment channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence and in-branch KYC interview is effectively mandatory for statutorily designated directors. Under Korean Financial Intelligence Unit and the Banking Act enforcement guidance, banks must verify customer identity face-to-face or through an equivalent certified process for non-face-to-face onboarding. In practice, Kookmin, Shinhan, Woori, and Hana require at least one director with signing authority to appear in person at a domestic branch to execute the account mandate. Foreign directors may complete identity verification remotely via consular notarization and apostilled documents only for nonsignatory beneficial owners; the bank's AML committee will generally reject a fully remote opening for the statutory director of a new entity with medium-risk commodity trading. A licensed Korean attorney-in-fact may attend the interview only if the board resolution explicitly grants proxy power, the attorney presents original or certified copies of the director's passport and corporate documents, and the bank conducts an additional two-step callback verification with the director.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The entity name 'Yuhan Hoesa' and the likely non-resident ownership structure trigger shell company suspicion, as Korea requires the substance of foreign-invested companies to be evidenced through real physical management and operational decision-making.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly apostilled certificate of incorporation and Articles of Incorporation; a certified register of shareholders identifying each natural person with more than 10% stake; tax residence certificates of all directors and Beneficial Ownership Report; a signed Korean office lease or ownership certificate with proof of rent payment; a three-year Korean business plan; and a corporate organizational chart showing the local finance and compliance officer physically located in the Korean registered office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wholesale urea and potassium chloride are dual-use agricultural chemicals with diversion risk, so KFIU and the bank's sanctions screening desk will require proof that the commodity is not being routed to sanctioned jurisdictions or used as a precursor for chemical weapons or narcotics.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed auditor-approved end-user certificate from each downstream buyer; a comprehensive restricted-party screening report from a commercial sanctions database covering all counterparties, beneficial owners, and payment routing banks; the full sales and purchase contracts stating the ISIC 4669 classification and non-military clause; Safety Data Sheets for urea and potassium chloride; and a shipping and packing list with the final port of delivery clearly showing the agricultural distribution channel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The capital subscription amount may appear disproportionately small or volatile relative to planned commodity turnover, creating an unexplained source-of-wealth and trade-finance red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original capital verification certificate issued by a Korean CPA; bank transfer receipts and foreign exchange transaction forms showing the source-of-funds and capital injection purpose code; audited financial statements of the parent shareholder for the previous two fiscal years; a 12-month projected cash flow forecast aligning the initial capital with one or two trade cycles; and genuine purchase orders, letters of intent, or a master supply agreement from at least three independent agricultural procurement companies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Korean banks must verify that the SWIFT LC and wire transfer flows match the real physical movement of prilled fertilizer, or the account will be flagged for trade-based money laundering and invoice manipulation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent commodity price benchmark screenshots from Argus, CRU, or the relevant fertilizer exchange for prilled urea and potassium chloride; original commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and inbound/outbound customs declarations; a copy of the trade finance loan or irrevocable letter of credit terms; and a third-party independent surveyor report with container numbers, gross weights, and port weighbridge receipts for the first three shipments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder must remit the capital injection through a SWIFT wire transfer to the Yuhan Hoesa's designated foreign exchange bank account. The payment must be referenced with the Korean purpose code for direct investment or 'capital increase' in the wire narrative; failure to include the code can cause the funds to be held in a suspense account. The bank will register the transaction in the Foreign Exchange Information System and issue a foreign investment verification report. For a KRW or USD-capital escrow account, the receiving bank will verify the corporate registration certificate and the capital verification certificate from a Korean CPA. The company must then notify the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy or the Bank of Korea through the designated bank within 30 days under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act. All funds must maintain a clean audit trail from the beneficial owner's bank account to the Korean receiver account; any interposition of an offshore EMI or personal account will trigger an automatic AML freeze.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for fertilizer imports and re-exports should use irrevocable documentary letters of credit (MT700) for large shipments, with a confirming bank in the supplier's country to mitigate seller's risk. For low-value or repeat transactions, SWIFT MT103 bank-to-bank wires are acceptable after the bank has seen a minimum of three reconcillied trade contracts and customs declarations. The company should also employ documentary collections (DP/DA) for established counterparties with a stable payment track record, but the bank will require the same underlying shipment evidence. Every outbound payment must be backed by the export declaration, commercial invoice, packing list, and the transportation document. For commodity settlement, the bank's clearing rails must pass through the KFTC for any KRW leg, and through SWIFT for USD/foreign currency legs; cryptocurrencies, non-bank EMI passes, and direct book-entry transfers are prohibited.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward exchange contracts with a designated foreign exchange bank on a documented underlying trade receivable or payable, with maturity aligned to the shipment date, renewable for a maximum 12-month term
Non-deliverable forwards on CNY or INR for trade counterparties in non-fully-convertible regional currencies, subject to bank counterparty limits and real commercial documentation

Cross-currency swaps between KRW and USD (or KRW and CNY) for medium-term trade financing or import settlement, reported to the Bank of Korea through the dealer bank, with no embedded speculative leverage

Plain vanilla USD/KRW options for managing commodity price cycle volatility; options premia paid from operating cash flow only; naked options and leveraged exotic structures are outside the permissible set under the FX soundness guidelines

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) - District Tax Office having jurisdiction over the registered head office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the last day of the third month following the end of the fiscal year. For a December 31 fiscal year-end, the deadline is March 31; if that day falls on a non-business day, the due date is postponed to the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty: 20% of the unpaid corporate tax if the return is not filed by the due date; 10% if filed late but before a tax assessment notice. Unfaithful report penalty: 10% of the understated amount, or 40% in case of fraudulent understatement. Late payment surcharge: 0.022% per day (approximately 8.03% p.a.) from the day after the statutory due date until the date of payment. If the NTS deems the company economically inactive after repeated defaults and no filings, it may cancel the business registration and instigate administrative strike-off through the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Local Income Tax on Corporate Income (Resident Surtax) Return and Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Government (City/County/District) Tax Revenue Division where the registered office is located
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the last day of the third month following the end of the fiscal year (March 31 for a December 31 year-end), filed and paid concurrently with the corporate income tax return; if the due date falls on a non-business day, the deadline shifts to the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 20% non-declaration penalty and a 10% under-reporting penalty apply to the local income tax due; a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.022% (approximately 8.03% p.a.) accrues from the day after the due date. Persistent non-payment may lead to forced collection, seizure of assets, and, in extreme cases, administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) through the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year; for a December 31 year-end, by March 31, or the next business day if a holiday.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act of up to KRW 3 million (approximately USD 2,150) for failure to file without just cause. Non-compliance may also trigger adverse findings under anti-money laundering reviews and restrict access to foreign exchange transaction benefits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Convening of Annual General Meeting of Members and Approval of Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company's corporate governance records (minutes retained at the registered head office); no active government filing unless audited
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be held within 3 months after the end of the fiscal year; March 31 for a December 31 year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under the Korean Commercial Act, directors or equivalent officers who fail to convene the meeting or prepare the required financial statements may be subject to an administrative fine of up to KRW 5 million. Repeated failure, together with other statutory defaults, can be used by the authorities as grounds for an administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements (with Independent Auditor's Report) Submission to DART
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) through the DART electronic disclosure system, only for companies subject to mandatory external audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days from the date of approval of the financial statements by the annual general meeting of members.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under the Act on External Audit of Corporations, failure to file or late filing can result in an administrative fine of up to KRW 30 million against the company or the responsible officer, and the company may be prohibited from issuing securities, subjected to sanctions, or reported to investigative agencies in serious cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Act on External Audit of Corporations and its Enforcement Decree, a Yuhan Hoesa (LLC) must appoint an independent licensed CPA auditor and obtain a statutory audit if it fails to qualify as a 'small company' as defined by Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree. A small company is one that satisfies ALL of the following at the end of the preceding fiscal year: (a) total assets of less than KRW 12 billion (approximately USD 8.6 million); (b) annual sales revenue of less than KRW 70 billion (approximately USD 50 million); and (c) average number of employees of less than 300. If ANY of these quantitative thresholds is exceeded, compulsory external audit becomes mandatory. Additionally, irrespective of size, listed companies, financial institutions and companies whose total assets equal or exceed KRW 100 billion are always subject to external audit. The audit must be performed by a registered Certified Public Accountant (CPA) under the Certified Public Accountant Act, and the audit report must be submitted to the FSS where required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS) for listed entities and entities required to adopt K-IFRS; non-listed companies, including a Yuhan Hoesa, may elect to apply K-GAAP (Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Practice or Accounting Standards for Non-Listed Entities) or K-IFRS. The adopted framework must be applied consistently and conform to the Act on External Audit of Corporations and the Korean Accounting Standards Board rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, a foreign-invested Yuhan Hoesa must file an annual report with MOTIE/KOTRA within 90 days after the fiscal year-end confirming the current foreign shareholding composition. Any change in equity ownership (including transfers of quotas or new issuances) by a non-resident must be reported within 30 days from the date of the change. For purely domestic ownership structures, there is no separate central UBO filing, but the company must maintain a complete and up-to-date Register of Members at its registered office, and any amendment to the register must be made promptly upon the transfer of quotas. In all cases, the company must respond to anti-money laundering due diligence requests from banks and counterparties by providing beneficial ownership information within a reasonable timeframe.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24% top marginal national corporate income tax rate (applicable to taxable income exceeding KRW 300 billion), plus a 10% local income tax surtax, producing a 26.4% aggregate headline marginal rate
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday is available for wholesale fertilizer distribution; standard progressive national rates of 9%, 19%, 21%, and 24% apply to taxable income bands up to KRW 200 million, KRW 20 billion, KRW 300 billion, and above KRW 300 billion respectively; free-zone tax incentives are not available because the Yuhan Hoesa operates as an agrochemical commodity wholesaler without qualifying manufacturing or free-zone logistics activity; limited R&D tax credits under the Special Tax Treatment Control Act and SME venture tax preferences may apply only if genuine qualifying research and development is performed in Korea; a passive fertilizer trading entity will normally bear the full statutory regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Tax Base and Tax Calculation Return for Domestic Corporations, e-filed through the National Tax Service HomeTax portal (www.hometax.go.kr)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual on a fiscal-year basis, with semi-annual interim corporate tax prepayment due for calendar-year taxpayers in July and January
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual corporate income tax return must be filed within three months from the end of the fiscal year (by March 31 for a December 31 fiscal year-end); an automatic one-month extension to April 30 applies when audited financial statements are attached; additional extension periods require National Tax Service approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity identification, shareholder disclosure, head office and branch information, and foreign shareholding percentage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a foreign-owned Yuhan Hoesa, complete the non-resident shareholder schedule with country of residence, shareholder identification, ownership ratio, and relationship to the ultimate parent; if the foreign shareholder is resident in a treaty jurisdiction, attach a Tax Residency Certificate and a beneficial ownership statement to support any reduced withholding tax on future profit distributions; failure to disclose foreign ownership may cause the National Tax Service to treat the corporation as a transparent conduit and assess deemed withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation from accounting income to taxable income: add-back of non-deductible expenses, deduction of tax-exempt income, application of carried-forward losses, and arm's-length adjustment of intercompany transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All cross-border purchases and sales of prilled urea and potassium chloride with foreign related companies must be disclosed in the related-party transaction schedule; contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation must be maintained if aggregate cross-border related-party transactions reach KRW 5,000,000,000; use the most appropriate OECD method and document why the selected method was chosen; if no transfer pricing documentation exists, the National Tax Service may estimate income and impose a 20% understatement penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of national corporate income tax at progressive rates and the 10% local income tax surtax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Korean entity has no unilateral power to exempt non-resident shareholders from withholding tax when profits are remitted; the corporate income tax shown in this box is separate from the 22% aggregate withholding tax on outbound dividends, interest, and royalties; a non-resident beneficial owner may not claim treaty relief through the corporate return and must instead file or substantiate the treaty application through the withholding agent before remittance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit, treaty-exempt foreign income, and other deduction/credit adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the Korean LLC earns foreign-source income or pays foreign withholding tax on cross-border fertilizer, logistics, or service transactions, attach foreign tax receipts and certified translations; however, the entity cannot claim a foreign tax credit for Korean withholding tax that should have been withheld from distributions to non-resident shareholders; treaty reductions on outbound payments are administered through the withholding process, not through this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund after interim prepayments and attached schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: When remitting dividends, interest, or royalties to a non-resident, the Korean payer must separately file a withholding tax return by the 10th day of the month following the payment month and remit national and local withholding taxes; the non-resident recipient must be listed in the withholding schedule with the treaty withholding rate applied and supporting documentation; a failure to withhold and remit makes the Korean corporation and its responsible officers jointly liable for the unwithheld tax and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 20% negligence penalty on the unpaid corporate income tax, plus periodic late-payment surcharges on arrears; a false or fraudulent return invokes the Punishment of Tax Crimes Act, including imprisonment up to three years and fines up to twice the amount of tax understated; the 10% local income tax surtax carries parallel penalties; if the evaded or fraudulently refunded tax exceeds aggravated statutory thresholds, the National Tax Service must refer the case to the public prosecutor and willful directors face criminal prosecution in addition to civil money penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% aggregate domestic withholding tax on outbound dividends (20% national income tax plus 2% local income tax surtax); bilateral tax treaties generally reduce the national tax component to 5% to 15% depending on ownership percentage and treaty provisions, with the reduced treaty rate subject to beneficial ownership and substance requirements.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident beneficial owner must supply the Korean withholding agent with a Tax Residency Certificate issued by the residence country, a signed beneficial ownership declaration, evidence of shareholding percentage, and supporting legal analysis of treaty entitlement; the Korean payer files an Application for Reduction or Exemption of Withholding Tax under Tax Treaty with the district tax office before remittance; if the application is not filed before payment, the non-resident may request a refund from the National Tax Service within three years of the payment date, accompanied by the Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership evidence, and proof that no conduit arrangement exists; if the principal purpose is to obtain treaty benefits, the Principal Purpose Test will deny relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to non-residents is subject to an aggregate 22% domestic withholding rate (20% national plus 2% local), with treaty-reduced rates commonly 10% or 0% for qualifying official or financial-institution lending; royalties paid for industrial, commercial, scientific, or copyright intellectual property are subject to an aggregate 22% domestic withholding rate, with treaty-reduced rates typically 5% to 15% depending on the IP category and treaty; treaty relief requires a valid Tax Residency Certificate, substantive beneficial ownership, and compliance with the pre-payment application or post-payment refund procedure; intercompany interest deductions are further limited by Korean thin-capitalization rules and arm's-length pricing requirements.
